description: Optional local-first data analysis pack for CSV, Sheets, SQL, notebooks, charts, audits, and reproducible recipes.

notes: This pack may hand final report or chart specs to rumi_workspace_pack when that pack is installed.
It does not duplicate workspace artifact generation, office export, or runtime tool implementations.
It remains useful without rumi_workspace_pack by producing analysis plans, recipes, and specs.

base_pack_promotion.reason: Optional domain pack; defaultspack remains the runtime core.

security_notes: No secrets, credentials, account tokens, external endpoints, or provider keys are embedded.
Network use is none by default; data sources are local files, pasted tables, local database descriptors, or user-provided exports.
Any runtime that executes SQL, notebooks, or file writes must apply its own approval and sandbox policy.
